rationale: Comparison for unit:shared.struct against lean:Shared/Syntax:Kind.isStruct, lean:Shared/TypingViews:StructType, lean:Shared/TypingViews:ClassTable.WellFormed, lean:Shared/TypingViews:KindValid. StructType looks up only ty.base and tests declaration.kind.isStruct; it does not inspect permission or view. ClassTable.WellFormed imposes StructType on every declared field of either struct kind, plus KindValid on all fields. kindAllows rejects shared classes and given shared-struct normalized types. Thus hiding a class's fields cannot make it shareable. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:shared.declarations.
